title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

suppliers.sup:70510: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Part 350011 – Motor IE3 7.5 kW: our proposal for 2027
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer and for many years of reliable supply.

The forecast for part:350011 increased by 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We attach three complete packages without an index clause, so both sides keep a stable, predictable price for 2027. The packages with longer payment terms give you a higher unit price, and the fixed volume gives your plant a reliable base load.

As this change needs your pricing committee's approval, could you please submit these packages at its next meeting? We would also welcome any cheaper motor variants you could offer for this application.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Part 350011 – Motor IE3 7.5 kW: our proposal for 2027
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We can accept your terms and await your order. Our Angebot is a price of €361.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This remains valid for 30 days.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Application Engineering: Please note that we build strictly according to your provided drawing, and we do not propose any design changes.
